claims.statement: The Enterprise Web App credential (admin authentication, available only to Adobe Technology Partner Program partners) lets the partner's backend generate access tokens for a customer organization's technical account using its own client_id, client_secret and the customer org_id.

sources.supports: The partner app can use its client_id and client_secret and the customer org_id to generate access tokens; the credential requires a secure backend server; only available to TPP partners.
sources.locator: sections "Enterprise Web App credential" and "How does it work?"

sources.supports: Admin authentication lists the Enterprise Web App credential.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Adobe documentation read for this candidate gives no prefix, alphabet, length or other format rule for this value; any example in it is a placeholder or a public identifier. Not researched beyond existence.

The pages read do not show whether this client secret differs in shape or handling from the OAuth Web App or OAuth Server-to-Server client secrets; it is kept as a separate candidate because it belongs to a different credential type, holder (a partner, not the customer) and authentication type. The merge-or-split question is open.
